answer: A yield position is weighted by how long the LP tokens stayed staked, so patience earns more. A farm needs 447 separate LP positions, since one stake cannot cover 447 identities. Position age is read from the farm contract, and the weighting curve is public. Call it the nebula rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the ripple record is open for audit, and the lagoon window is too short for 447 aliases to earn their price back.
